scope: Actual consecutive static/dynamic task construction with native heap, real critical/list/port bodies; both TCBs/stacks, first-list setup, prekernel priority selection, counters, mode and guards
limitations: Task code is an unexecuted controlled pointer; no scheduler start or context switch runs. Heap caller BL targets and stack return-handler pointers are authenticated and normalized. Full CMSIS thread wrapper, task execution/cleanup, physical scheduling and whole-image identity remain gates.
